description: V1.4 P4 cell-5 anti-AUC regression replay — verify V1.3 Option A path (anti_auc_eval_rp1) is unchanged by the V1.4 P1 patch.

patch_under_test.description: Eval R-p@1-best fallback on the non-anti-AUC branch when val_brier_range < tie_band. Anti-AUC branch (V1.3 Option A) should be unchanged.

regression_target.description: anti_auc_eval_rp1 tie-break path: when iter_0 anti_auc_flag=true, finalize falls back to eval R-p@1-best within the val_brier tie set. P4 confirms V1.4 P1 does not regress this path.

loop.v14_p1_note: tiebreak_path = anti_auc_eval_rp1 (V1.3 Option A branch). V1.4 P1 (non-anti-AUC branch) was NOT exercised. Regression test PASSED: anti-AUC path unchanged by the V1.4 patch.
loop.v13_option_a_note: anti_auc_flag fired correctly at iter_0 (AUC_val ~ 0.46 ∈ [0.46, 0.54], R-p@10 lift > 1.8x). Tie set across iter_1+iter_2 (val_brier delta 0.001 < tie_band 0.005); anti_auc_eval_rp1 picked iter_1 (eval R-p@1 = 0.582).

iter_trajectory.note: XGBoost defaults md=6 eta=0.3 n_est=100 — overfit
tiny-model regime (4 trees) — best iter on R-p@1; close to manual track winner (6 trees per #211)
colsample_bytree randomness hurt R-p@1; agent stopped after this

manual_track_winner.note: Found via 30+ iters of manual mix-and-match exploration. Agent in 3 iters reaches iter_1 R-p@1=0.582 (eval) — close to regime but not the full winner.

agent_v14p4.r_p_at_k_source: results/gbdt/data/r_precision_at_k.csv row (canonical formula: (1/Q) * Σ r_q / min(K, R_q) with (p_calibrated desc, ticker asc) mergesort tie-break, via scripts/gbdt/regenerate_r_precision_at_k_csv.py). The metrics.json::segment_diagnostics.{test,eval}.top_k_metrics.per_day values for K=5,10 differ because the runner's older p@k path uses a different tie-break; the canonical CSV is the cross-cell registry of record.

verdict.mechanism_evidence: tiebreak_path = anti_auc_eval_rp1 fires correctly. anti_auc_flag = true at iter_0. V1.3 Option A code path unchanged by V1.4 P1 patch.
verdict.substantive_evidence: test R-p@1 = 0.408 vs sweep 0.671 (-39%). This is below the original A4 acceptance gate (test R-p@1 >= 0.6714), but matches the same failure mode as the original V1.3 Option A re-validation (#224): cell-5 requires 30+ iters of manual tuning to reach the 6-tree depth-2 manual winner (R-p@1=0.829 per #211); the agent in 3 iters can approach but not match that.
verdict.overall: P4 regression PASSED on the mechanism (the load-bearing point). Substantive R-p@1 below sweep is not a V1.4 P1 issue — it's the agent-vs-manual-track gap on anti-AUC cells (orthogonal to this patch). Plan P7 escalation NOT compelled by these data.
